# ScribeCat 0.25.8

## Fixed
- Restore the inline PDF viewer after closing its split-view companion.
- Keep PDF all-pages view height tied to the actual page grid instead of the single-page viewer sizing.
- Render PDF overview pages at higher resolution for clearer previews.
- Keep responsive one-column/two-column PDF and PowerPoint overviews.
- Add direct text-copy actions for Word documents and PowerPoint slides.
- Keep PowerPoint slide artwork rendered together with its text.

## Docker
- Publish `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.8`.
- Pin Server Edition Compose defaults to `0.25.8`.
